column6: Eliot's "The Metaphysical Poets" (1921) and his idea of fused thought and feeling draw on Donne and the conceit.
Thoreau's philosophy of nature and self-reliance rests on Emersonian Transcendentalism.
The Romantic rebel-hero (Blake, Shelley, Byron) was shaped by reading Milton's Satan as heroic.
Post-war disillusionment in fiction follows the war poets' break with heroic language.
Dystopia inverts and answers the utopian tradition; reading it presupposes the utopian model.
Kabuki borrowed plays and conventions from Noh; Noh is the older form against which Kabuki is usually defined.
Elizabethan drama inherited the Vice figure, allegorical structure and mixed comic/serious tone from medieval plays.
Tall tales are a concrete, child-level case of legend built on real or semi-real figures (Crockett, Appleseed).
Why stories about single natural features are the child-level precursor of cosmogonic myth.
